---
title: "Penguin Analysis"
author: "Shaurya Gaur"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
```

## This is the average bill length

```{r}
penguins |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarise(
    average_bill_length = mean(bill_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable()
```
## The penguin graph

```{r}
penguins |>
  ggplot(aes(x = bill_length_mm, y = flipper_length_mm)) +
  geom_point(color="blue")
```
